message: Nothing was changed: 13 blocks cannot be rotated: 2 blocks in a frame, 1 coordinate setting or shift, 1 subprogram or macro call, 1 block with a variable or a calculation, 2 cycles not reviewed, 3 cycles with positions of their own, 1 free contour (FK) block, 1 tangential arc or arc through a point, 1 move around a pole that is not known. No machine chosen: a word whose reading depends on the machine would refuse the run.

findings.message: 4 LP PR+5 PA+30: a move around the pole while the pole is not known or not moved with the path.
6 L X+Q1 Y+0 FMAX: a variable or a calculation in a word the transform has to change; gEdit only changes written numbers.
7 CT X+10 Y+10: a tangential arc or an arc through a point; gEdit cannot check it after the transform.
9 FL LEN 10 AN+0: a free contour (FK): its points depend on each other and on the elements around them; gEdit does not move them.
11 CYCL DEF 254 NUTKREIS ~: a cycle with positions of its own (a pattern, a pocket, a contour elsewhere) that gEdit does not move.
Q216=+50 ;MITTE 1. ACHSE ~: a cycle with positions of its own (a pattern, a pocket, a contour elsewhere) that gEdit does not move.
Q217=+50 ;MITTE 2. ACHSE: a cycle with positions of its own (a pattern, a pocket, a contour elsewhere) that gEdit does not move.
12 CYCL DEF 999 UNBEKANNT ~: a cycle whose parameters gEdit has not been told about (or one the database does not know); its positions could not be moved with the path.
Q1=+5: a cycle whose parameters gEdit has not been told about (or one the database does not know); its positions could not be moved with the path.
13 CALL LBL 1: a subprogram or macro call: the called program's positions are not in this document, so it cannot be moved with the rest.

15 CYCL DEF 7.1 X+10: this sets or shifts the coordinate system or writes offsets (a local shift, a coordinate set, a data setting that changes offsets); gEdit does not move the values it sets, so the positions after it would no longer match the moved path.

16 PLANE SPATIAL SPA+0 SPB+30 SPC+0 TURN MB MAX FMAX: a coordinate rotation, mirror, scaling, polar command or tilted plane is in force here; gEdit cannot tell where these positions are. Move the path without it, or cancel it first.
17 L X+10 Y+0 FMAX: a coordinate rotation, mirror, scaling, polar command or tilted plane is in force here; gEdit cannot tell where these positions are. Move the path without it, or cancel it first.
